full_prompt_en: A square graphic narrative illustration shows an orange tram approaching around a bend in a quiet city street under a pale blue-green sky. Tall brick buildings rise along the left edge, their rectangular windows and dark doorways forming a repeated vertical rhythm. The tram appears in the middle-left, its rounded front lit warm orange and its long side receding toward the background. Pale windows run across the upper half of the vehicle, and the lower body stays a deeper red-orange. Two parallel rail lines curve from the bottom foreground toward the tram, guiding the eye through the street. At right, a huge tree with densely stippled golden foliage towers above a dark fence and narrow pale railing. A smaller blue-green shrub fills the space below its crown near the middle-right. More buildings stand behind the tram, their dark teal facades and chimney stacks partly hidden by the bend. The right foreground is a light sidewalk bordered by the fence, while broad blue-gray street shadow covers much of the lower-left corner. No people are prominent, and no legible signs appear. The viewpoint is at pedestrian height, looking gently down the rails. Low warm light from the left catches the tram, building edges, and tree leaves, while long cool shadows stretch across the pavement. Flat, clean color planes are enriched by fine grain and small repeated marks rather than heavy brush texture. The overall composition places the bright vehicle and golden tree on opposite sides of a calm curved route, giving the street a nostalgic, expectant mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形图像叙事插画呈现一辆橙色有轨电车，在浅蓝绿色天空下沿安静城市街道的弯道驶来。高高的砖楼沿左缘升起，长方窗与深色门洞形成重复竖向节奏。电车出现在中左，圆润车头被暖橙光照亮，长车身向背景后退。浅色车窗横过车辆上半部，下半车身则是更深的红橙色。两条平行轨道从底部前景弯向电车，引导视线穿过街道。右侧一棵巨大树木枝叶密布、点状金黄，耸立在深色围栏和窄浅色栏杆之上。一丛较小的蓝绿色灌木填在树冠下方、中右附近。电车后方还有建筑，深青外墙和烟囱部分被弯道遮住。右侧前景是沿围栏延伸的浅色人行道，宽阔蓝灰街影覆盖左下大部分。没有醒目行人，也没有可读标志。视点在行人高度，沿铁轨轻轻向前望。左侧低角度暖光照亮电车、楼缘与树叶，长长的冷色阴影越过路面。平坦干净的色面由细颗粒和小型重复痕迹丰富，而非厚重笔触。整体构图把亮色车辆与金树放在安静弯道两侧，让街道带有怀旧和期待感。
style_prompt_en: Graphic narrative illustration uses simplified architectural planes, clean edges, and fine stippled texture. Muted teal, slate blue, cream, and near-black establish a calm ground for concentrated orange and golden accents. Long diagonal shadows and curved perspective lines lead into a compact middle-distance focus. Repeated windows, rail-like strokes, and leaf dots produce rhythm without crowding the broad color fields. Low warm light makes selected edges glow while cool shadow occupies large contiguous surfaces. The framing balances a tall vertical mass against a rounded textured canopy, with substantial open pavement between. The overall effect is quiet, cinematic, and gently nostalgic.
style_prompt_zh: 图像叙事插画使用简化的建筑平面、干净边缘和细点状肌理。低饱和青绿、石板蓝、乳白与近黑为集中的橙色和金色重音建立平静底面。长斜影与弯曲透视线通向紧凑的中景焦点。重复的窗、轨道状笔痕和叶片点形成节奏，却不挤满宽阔色面。低处暖光使选定边缘发亮，冷色阴影占据大片连续表面。取景以一侧高耸竖形平衡另一侧圆润有肌理的树冠，中间留有充裕开放路面。整体效果安静、有电影感，并带轻柔怀旧气息。
theme_en: An orange tram rounding a quiet street beside a golden tree
theme_zh: 一辆橙色有轨电车转过安静街道，旁边是一棵金色大树
name: Jon McNaught
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
